note: New Zealand: Australian citizens are granted the Australian Resident Visa on arrival, which lets them live, work and study there (the Trans-Tasman arrangement). Anyone else coming to work on a film, video or production whose skills New Zealand's entertainment industry can't supply needs the Entertainers Work Visa, on a job offer, for the time the work needs. Immigration New Zealand names no days of such work without a visa.

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand, Australian Resident Visa
sources.said: be an Australian citizen, or a permanent resident with an NZeTA ... This visa lets you: live, work and study in New Zealand.

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand, Entertainers Work Visa
sources.said: Apply for this visa if you want to work on a film, video or production in New Zealand and you have specific skills that cannot be met by New Zealand's entertainment industry.
